extension.description:
A zero-dependency VS Code extension that watches files for changes and delivers them to the macOS Notification Center.
Built first of all for Claude Code hooks inside an egress-blocked devcontainer, but any file can be watched.
(macOS only)
capabilities.untrustedWorkspaces.descrip: chirin never executes workspace code. Watch targets and settings come only from the host-side config, and the workspace (container) content is treated as read-only data.
config.configPath.description: Path to config.json. When empty, `~/.config/chirin/config.json` is used.
config.showInEditorToast.description: Also show a notification inside the VS Code window, in addition to the OS notification.

walkthrough.description: Four steps to get macOS notifications from Claude Code running inside a devcontainer.
walkthrough.createConfig.title: Create the config file
walkthrough.createConfig.description:
Creates the config.json in `~/.config/chirin/` that lists the files to watch and what to notify. The editor opens afterwards, so adjust `watch` to your own working directory and save.
[Create config file](command:chirin.init)
walkthrough.validateConfig.title: Check the watch targets
walkthrough.validateConfig.description:
Validates the config and lists, in the output panel, the files that are actually watched after glob expansion. If this is empty, the paths in `watch` do not match.
[Validate config](command:chirin.validate)
walkthrough.allowNotification.title: Allow notifications on macOS
walkthrough.allowNotification.descriptio:
Sends a single test notification. **The first time, macOS shows its notification permission prompt here** — be sure to allow it. Without permission, every later notification is silently dropped.
[Send test notification](command:chirin.test)
walkthrough.installHook.title: Install the hook into your project
walkthrough.installHook.description:
Installs into the workspace the hook that makes Claude Code write out its events. Run it with **the repository you want notifications for** open.
[Install hook](command:chirin.installHook)
